This commonly happens when you have either not navigated to the expected origin or have navigated away unexpectedly.

Using `cy.origin()` to wrap the commands run on `https://trial-1290191.okta.com` will likely fix this issue.

`cy.origin('https://trial-1290191.okta.com', () => {`
`  <commands targeting https://trial-1290191.okta.com go here>`
